ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels to 60% low-intensity black pixels on the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions are mapped to the distal regions of both lobes; extensive low-intensity black mottling is interspersed within these white regions, concentrated heavily along the inner margins; a solid low-intensity black mask covers the central peduncle attachment and proximal lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; serrations are most pronounced on the outer margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a multi-inflection curve transitioning from concave near the median notch to convex toward the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a continuous upward convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and at discrete points along the trailing edge serrations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular indentation on the outer third of the right lobe trailing edge, deviating from the standard serration pattern; visible high-contrast protrusions at the extreme right tip.
